name: j2me-web
description: Self-hosted web player for Java ME games, powered by KEmulator nnmod (Bridge frontend)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @j2me-web/protocol && npm run build -w @j2me-web/api && npm run build -w @j2me-web/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @j2me-web/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @j2me-web/protocol -w @j2me-web/api -w @j2me-web/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @j2me-web/api && npm run test -w @j2me-web/web
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/browser.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-ux.mjs && node tests/e2e/round3.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-features.mjs && node tests/e2e/text-input.mjs && node tests/e2e/pause.mjs && node tests/e2e/soundfont.mjs && node tests/e2e/player-tools.mjs && node tests/e2e/emulation-options.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/orientation.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/setup.mjs && node tests/e2e/recovery.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/ui-feedback.mjs && node --import tsx tests/e2e/genres.mjs && node tests/e2e/phone-expansion.mjs
scripts.build:dev: VITE_DEVELOPER_BUILD=true npm run build && npm run build:dev -w @j2me-web/api
scripts.fixtures:dev: bash tests/fixtures/testmidlet/build.sh runtime/build/kemulator/KEmulator.jar && bash tests/fixtures/labgames/build.sh runtime/build/kemulator/KEmulator.jar
